contract.description: Fetch clusters of old, similar journal entries that are due for distillation into durable facts; each group carries its entry records (id, content, timestamps), similarity and the stalest access time, and memory_stats reports the whole backlog as pendingCompaction. Run the loop when pendingCompaction grows or the human asks to compact: for each group, write one kind=fact memory_remember capturing the durable point, then memory_forget each consumed entry with a reason like "compacted into <new memory id>". This is how journal noise becomes the standing encyclopedia - distill deliberately, never speculatively, and never tombstone entries you did not actually distill. Candidates come from one tome at a time; memory_forget stays tome-bound, so distill within the tome you are reading. upstream_unavailable means the store is unreachable; the call is read-only and writes nothing.
contract.name: memory_compact_candidates
contract.title: Get compaction candidates
